newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil March trade deficit seen at $1 bln - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil March trade deficit seen at $1 bln - paper.

text.p: Brazil's March trade deficit should hit $1.03 billion, bringing the trade gap in the first three months of this year to $3.06 billion, a newspaper said.
Folha de Sao Paulo said the government hoped April's trade gap could be reduced to between $600 million and $700 million as a result of restrictions introduced on import financing.
The government announced measures last week limiting import financing of under a year to prevent importers from benefiting from low international interest rates.
Official trade balance figures for March are expected to be released on Friday.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
